chapterTag.category: AP Calc AB Unit 8 — Applications of Integration

body.en: Unit 8 · Applications of Integration covers essential College Board AP Calculus AB competencies across foundational mechanics, intermediate analysis, and advanced FRQ problem solving.

blocks.heading: Level 1 · Foundations — Average Value of a Function & Area Between Curves

body.en: Average value: \(f_{\text{avg}} = \frac{1}{b-a}\int_a^b f(x)\,dx\). Area between curves: \(\int_a^b [f(x) - g(x)]\,dx\) where \(f(x) \ge g(x)\).

Average Value: \[ f_{\text{avg}} = \frac{1}{b-a}\int_a^b f(x)\,dx. \] Area Between Curves: \[ A = \int_a^b (y_{\text{top}} - y_{\text{bottom}})\,dx \quad \text{or} \quad \int_c^d (x_{\text{right}} - x_{\text{left}})\,dy. \]

question.en:
Level 1 · Foundations

Find the average value of \(f(x) = 3x^2\) on the interval \([1, 3]\).

blocks.heading: Level 2 · Medium — Volumes by Cross-Sections (Squares, Semicircles, Triangles)

body.en: Volume formula: \(V = \int_a^b A(x)\,dx\) where \(A(x)\) is the cross-sectional area perpendicular to the x-axis.

question.en:
Level 2 · Medium

A solid has base bounded by \(y = \sqrt{x}\), \(y = 0\), and \(x = 4\). Cross sections perpendicular to the x-axis are squares. Find the volume.

solution.en: Side length of square cross-section: \(s = \sqrt{x}\). Cross-sectional area: \(A(x) = s^2 = (\sqrt{x})^2 = x\). Volume: \[ V = \int_0^4 x\,dx = \left[ \frac{x^2}{2} \right]_0^4 = \frac{16}{2} = \mathbf{8}. \]

blocks.heading: Level 3 · Advanced — Volumes of Solids of Revolution (Discs & Washers)

body.en: Disc method: \(V = \pi\int r^2\,dx\). Washer method: \(V = \pi\int (R^2 - r^2)\,dx\) around horizontal and vertical axes of rotation.

question.en:
Level 3 · Advanced

Find the volume of the solid generated by revolving the region bounded by \(y = x^2\) and \(y = 4\) about the line \(y = 4\).

solution.en: Intersections occur at \(x = -2\) and \(x = 2\). Radius of disc: \(r = 4 - x^2\). Volume: \[ V = \pi\int_{-2}^2 (4 - x^2)^2\,dx = 2\pi\int_0^2 (16 - 8x^2 + x^4)\,dx = 2\pi\left[ 16x - \frac{8x^3}{3} + \frac{x^5}{5} \right]_0^2 = 2\pi\left( 32 - \frac{64}{3} + \frac{32}{5} \right) = \mathbf{\frac{512\pi}{15}} \approx 107.23. \]
